info.title: Subscriber CLTV API
info.description:
Feeds the Subscriber CLTV dashboard: predicted 12-month value, activity and
segments for every customer, and how customers move between segments over time.

**Two levels.** Scores are worked out for each SIM, then added up to the
customer who holds them. The overview, the customer list and the transitions
count **customers**; open a customer to see each of their SIMs.

A screen-by-screen guide with worked examples is in `docs/API_GUIDE.md`.

**Conventions**

* Money is in the run's currency (`/api/meta` → `run.currency`).
* A *share* or a probability is a fraction between 0 and 1 (0.74 means 74 %).
* Dates are text in the form `YYYY-MM-DD`.
* Names of segments, tiers and bands are always returned in English. Treat them
  as fixed keys and translate them for display.
* Filters are repeatable query parameters: `?segment=At risk&segment=Churned&tier=Gold`
  keeps SIMs that are (At risk **or** Churned) **and** Gold. Leave a filter out to not filter on it.
* Errors come back as `{"detail": "what went wrong"}`.

get.description:
Everything that does not change between requests: the analysis date and assumptions, the
forecast back-test, the allowed values of each filter, and the transition dates.
The dashboard calls this once when it opens.

get.summary: All figures on the Overview page
get.description:
Headline numbers, value concentration, and breakdowns by segment, department,
recency band and tenure band. **Everything here counts customers**, each with all
their SIMs taken together. Agent and reseller accounts are left out.

The segment breakdown ignores the segment filter, and the department breakdown
ignores the department filter, so every option stays visible while some are selected.

get.summary: One page of the customer list
get.description:
The main list: one row per customer, with their SIMs taken together.
Open a row with `/api/customers/{customer_id}` to see each SIM.

The search text matches the customer ID, or the MSISDN key of any of the customer's SIMs.
Filtering, searching, sorting and paging all happen in the database.

spend_error_pct.description: Predicted vs actual total spend, in percent.

mae_recharge_days.title: Mae Recharge Days
mae_recharge_days.description: Average absolute miss per SIM, in recharge-days.

bucket.title: Bucket
bucket.description: Repeat recharge-days before the holdout period.

actual.title: Actual
actual.description: Average recharge-days per SIM that really happened in the holdout.

predicted.title: Predicted
predicted.description: Average recharge-days per SIM the model predicted.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: Hashed national ID. Starts with C, or S for a SIM that could not be linked to a person.

sims_scored.title: Sims Scored
sims_scored.description: Their SIMs that are scored (connected, with a recharge). The number of rows in the drill-down.

sims_registered.title: Sims Registered
sims_registered.description: SIMs registered to them, scored or not.

lapsed_sims.title: Lapsed Sims
lapsed_sims.description: How many of their scored SIMs are, on their own, in a risk segment (silent 61 days or more).

over_sim_limit.title: Over Sim Limit
over_sim_limit.description: True for an agent or reseller account (more SIMs than run.max_sims).

department.title: Department
department.description: Department of their most valuable SIM.

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: From the customer's combined R, F and M. 'Agent or reseller' if over_sim_limit.

cltv_tier.title: Cltv Tier
cltv_tier.description: Platinum, Gold, Silver or Bronze by customer value; 'Unranked' if over_sim_limit. Shown as 'Class' on the dashboard.

r_score.title: R Score
r_score.description: 1-5 from the recency band; 0 if over_sim_limit.

days_since_last.title: Days Since Last
days_since_last.description: RECENCY: analysis date minus the last recharge on any of their SIMs.

recharge_days.title: Recharge Days
recharge_days.description: FREQUENCY: days on which any of their SIMs recharged.

monetary.title: Monetary
monetary.description: MONETARY: run.margin x spend across all their SIMs in the history window.

tenure_months.title: Tenure Months
tenure_months.description: Months since their oldest scored SIM was activated.

p_active.title: P Active
p_active.description: Probability that at least one of their SIMs is still active.

cltv_12m.title: Cltv 12M
cltv_12m.description: Predicted 12-month value: the sum of their SIMs.

value_at_risk.title: Value At Risk
value_at_risk.description: Sum of their SIMs' value at risk.

contact_msisdn_key.title: Contact Msisdn Key
contact_msisdn_key.description: Their most valuable SIM: the number to contact.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: One customer: their scored SIMs taken together.

sims.title: Sims
sims.description: The customer's scored SIMs, most valuable first.

sims_by_segment.title: Sims By Segment
sims_by_segment.description: How many of those SIMs are in each SIM segment, e.g. {'Champions': 1, 'Churned': 1}.

CustomerDetail.description: The drill-down: one customer, then each of their SIMs with its own segment and value.

multi_sim_customers.description: Matching customers with more than one SIM registered.

customers_with_lapsed_sim.title: Customers With Lapsed Sim
customers_with_lapsed_sim.description: Matching customers in a healthy segment who nevertheless have at least one SIM that has gone quiet. They moved their usage; they did not leave.

average_value.title: Average Value
average_value.description: total_value / customers (0 if there are none).

total_monetary.title: Total Monetary
total_monetary.description: Sum of monetary: margin x spend in the history window.

value_at_risk.title: Value At Risk
value_at_risk.description: Value expected to be lost because SIMs may have lapsed.

likely_active_customers.title: Likely Active Customers
likely_active_customers.description: Customers whose probability of being active is at or above the threshold.

accounts_over_sim_limit.title: Accounts Over Sim Limit
accounts_over_sim_limit.description: Agent or reseller accounts, which are left out of every figure here. Ignores the filters.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Value tiers, best first. Shown as 'Class' on the dashboard.

Lists.title: Lists
Lists.description: The allowed values for each filter, in display order.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: What the data cleaning read and removed.

transition_dates.title: Transition Dates
transition_dates.description: Snapshot dates available for /api/transitions, oldest first. The last one is the analysis date.

deciles.title: Deciles
deciles.description: Up to ten rows; fewer only if fewer than ten customers match.

by_segment.title: By Segment
by_segment.description: Every segment, in display order. Ignores the segment filter.

by_department.title: By Department
by_department.description: Departments with customers, highest average value first. Ignores the department filter.

analysis_date.title: Analysis Date
analysis_date.description: The day the analysis was done. Recency is counted back from it.

obs_start.title: Obs Start
obs_start.description: First day of recharge history used.

obs_end.title: Obs End
obs_end.description: Last day of recharge history used. Same as analysis_date.

calib_end.title: Calib End
calib_end.description: The model is back-tested on the days after this date.

is_synthetic.title: Is Synthetic
is_synthetic.description: 1 if the data is synthetic (show a warning), 0 if real.

margin.title: Margin
margin.description: Share of recharge spend counted as value: monetary = margin x spend, and 12-month value is margin x predicted spend.

discount_rate.title: Discount Rate
discount_rate.description: Annual discount rate applied to future value.

alive_threshold.title: Alive Threshold
alive_threshold.description: A customer or SIM is 'likely active' at or above this probability.

max_sims.title: Max Sims
max_sims.description: An account with more SIMs than this is treated as an agent or reseller.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: The customer this SIM belongs to.

segment.title: Segment
segment.description: From this SIM's own R, F and M. May differ from the customer's segment.

cltv_tier.title: Cltv Tier
cltv_tier.description: Platinum, Gold, Silver or Bronze among SIMs.

days_since_last.title: Days Since Last
days_since_last.description: RECENCY: analysis date minus this SIM's last recharge.

recharge_days.title: Recharge Days
recharge_days.description: FREQUENCY: days with at least one recharge in the window.

monetary.title: Monetary
monetary.description: MONETARY: run.margin x this SIM's spend in the history window.

tenure_months.title: Tenure Months
tenure_months.description: Months since the line was activated.

t_days_observed.title: T Days Observed
t_days_observed.description: Days since the first recharge seen in the window (the model's clock).

p_alive.title: P Alive
p_alive.description: Probability the SIM is still active.

exp_recharge_days_90d.title: Exp Recharge Days 90D
exp_recharge_days_90d.description: Expected recharge-days in the next 90 days.

total.title: Total
total.description: SIMs matching the filters and search.

page.title: Page
page.description: Page returned; the first page is 0.

highest_value.title: Highest Value
highest_value.description: Largest 12-month value among ALL matching SIMs (not just this page). 0 if nothing matches.

segmented_at_baseline.title: Segmented At Baseline
segmented_at_baseline.description: Customers that had a segment on the baseline date.

stayed.title: Stayed
stayed.description: Of those, customers in the same segment on the comparison date.

top_segment.title: Top Segment
top_segment.description: The best segment (first in the list).

top_segment_kept.title: Top Segment Kept
top_segment_kept.description: Customers in the top segment on both dates.

slipped_into_risk.title: Slipped Into Risk
slipped_into_risk.description: Customers that moved from a healthy segment to a risk segment or were disconnected.

disconnected.title: Disconnected
disconnected.description: Segmented customers with no connected SIM left by the comparison date.

new_since_baseline.title: New Since Baseline
new_since_baseline.description: Customers whose first recharge came after the baseline date.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Segment on the baseline date (matrix rows). The last row is customers that were new.

cols.title: Cols
cols.description: Segment on the comparison date (matrix columns). The last column is disconnected customers.

matrix.title: Matrix
matrix.description: matrix[r][c] = customers that were in rows[r] and are now in cols[c].

row_shares.title: Row Shares
row_shares.description: matrix[r][c] / row_totals[r]: each cell as a share of its row.
